# Incident Response Standard

Revision: v01. Effective: 2023-03-23. Owner: Director of IT Operations.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for incident response. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to every employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least every 6 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R2.** Exceptions to this policy are approved in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.
- **R3.** Staff complete the related training within thirty days of joining and annually thereafter.
- **R4.** Requests under this policy are approved or declined within 2 working days of submission.
- **R5.** Shared accounts are prohibited; every action is attributable to a named individual.
- **R6.** All access to in-scope systems is logged, and the logs are protected from modification.
- **R7.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 60 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R8.** Affected parties are notified within 30 days of a confirmed event.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Director of IT Operations, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
